WQ-01.role: Sentinel sonde for the Inner Harbor spill (valves open 04:00Z to 05:30Z D0); should react within the hour. Exact relation to the TERM-01 berth is set by the maritime registry.

WQ-03.role: Oil reaches Nueces Bay marshes by D+2.

WQ-06.role: Oil reaches North Beach by D+2 to D+3.

GAUGE-14.role: Canon bay tide gauge. Offline D0 to D+5 (flooded); surge about 3.4 m at 06:00Z D0 is seen at the other gauges.

GAUGE-12.role: Nueces River rises from D-7 with pre-storm rain (EVT-0203).

GAUGE-13.role: Second river gauge promised by the rendering rules; no canon event names it.

_air_monitors.note: Rendering rules promise 20 air-quality sensors at 15-minute readings. The four old ids are kept (AQS-480-001..004, AQS-MOB-001) but all were re-sited: three of the old points were not where their names said and the mobile unit's points were in the ship channel. No public source for real monitor positions was reachable, so monitors sit on real public sites (schools, fire stations, airport weather station) or beside real roads.
